description: What a process profiles while line profiling's on.

app.description: The process: the host's, Baude's or Record's.

functions.description: What's profiled: functions (module.function, module.Class.method) and modules (every function in it): what telemetry_set named for it, else what its counts picked (picked), else Baude's developers' pick (lineprofile.DEFAULTS) till there are counts.

default.description: Nothing's named for it by telemetry_set: what it profiles is picked by its counts (or the developers' pick, before there are any).

error.description: Why it isn't profiling what it's told to (a name not found; line_profiler not installed).

picked.description: What its counts picked for it now, each with the count that picked it (none while something's named, or nothing's counted yet).
